The instructor's approach to the course left much to be desired. There was a significant lack of clarity about class schedules, as we often did not know when or even if the class would be held on a given day. Announcements of cancellations were sometimes made only an hour before class, which caused unnecessary inconvenience for students who had already arrived on campus.

Communication was also a major challenge. The instructor discouraged students from emailing and stated that he did not check his email. Instead, a WhatsApp group was used for communication, but this environment felt unwelcoming. Students who asked questions or shared their thoughts were often met with dismissive or harsh responses, which discouraged participation and open discussion.

Another major concern was the absence of a proper syllabus. This made it difficult for students to understand the course structure, expectations, and key deadlines. It also gave the impression that the instructor had not invested enough effort in planning and organizing the course content.

Overall, it felt like the instructor lacked the motivation or interest to teach the class effectively. This perception was reinforced by frequent cancellations, a lack of engagement, and limited constructive communication. A more structured, respectful, and student-centered approach would significantly improve the learning experience. Students deserve an instructor who is committed to their development and takes the role seriously.
